# Position Xero

> Position Xero builds websites for South African businesses. The website is built free, in code, and goes live within 7 days; the business then pays a monthly package for hosting and care: Minimum R490, Standard R990 (includes SEO, blog posts and Google Business Profile management), Growth R1,490 or Full House R4,990 a month. No contract. Based in Centurion, Gauteng.

> Last updated: 2026-11-12

## Built free, then one monthly price

- **What "built free" means**: there is no build fee. We code your website from scratch and you pay the monthly package from the first month. The domain is not included in any package; we register it for you at cost. Your domain, email and words are yours from day one, and the website files are yours after 12 paid months. Cancel with 30 days' notice and they go with you.
- **Minimum, R490 a month (R4,900 a year)**: a website of up to 5 pages, built from our designs and tailored to your business; we write the words; hosting, security updates, backups and SSL; up to 30 minutes of small changes a month; 1 email mailbox plus free email aliases; WhatsApp button and contact form; Google Business Profile set up; live within 7 days.
- **Standard, R990 a month (R9,900 a year), recommended**: everything in Minimum plus on-site SEO; 2 blog posts a month; Google Business Profile managed (a weekly post and review replies); Google Search Console and Bing set up; 2 mailboxes; up to 1 hour of changes a month; a monthly report in plain English.
- **Growth, R1,490 a month (R14,900 a year)**: everything in Standard plus 4 blog posts a month; Google Analytics with call, WhatsApp and form tracking; a review-request kit; 10 directory listings; 3 mailboxes; up to 2 hours of changes a month; a quarterly call.
- **Full House, R4,990 a month (R49,900 a year)**: everything in Growth plus full SEO for one local business website (technical SEO, local pages, link building, competitor tracking); 8 blog posts a month; monthly conversion improvements using heatmaps; 5 mailboxes; up to 4 hours of changes a month, done the same working day.
- **Pay yearly**: pay for 10 months, get 12. The package runs to the end of the paid year and is not renewed if cancelled. A missed 7-day launch on a yearly plan adds one free month to the end of the year.
- **Our three commitments** (about our own work; no result is promised): live within 7 days of receiving your details, or the first month is free; no contract, cancel with 30 days' notice, and your domain, email and words go with you; after 12 paid months the website files are yours too.
- **On every site we build**: structured data that matches the page, an llms.txt file and a robots.txt that lets AI search crawlers in.
- **No guarantees of results**: no package includes a guarantee of rankings, traffic, leads or AI mentions.
- **Everything else is priced on the brief**: Google Ads and Meta Ads management, immersive 3D or scroll-animated builds (like https://www.positionxero.com/experience), online stores, and bigger or multi-location projects, including SEO for several locations or national campaigns. WhatsApp: https://wa.me/27662412155?text=Hi%20there%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20enquire%20about%20getting%20some%20of%20your%20offerings.

## How we work

- Position Xero is founder-led by Ronnie James Botes (web development and SEO) and Keegan Shane Haumann (full-stack development). Clients work with the person who actually runs their service, with a founder close to the account.
- We are based in Centurion, Gauteng, and work with businesses across South Africa online, over WhatsApp, phone and video calls. There is no office to visit.
- How to start: WhatsApp +27 66 241 2155 with your business name and what you do. Tell us about the business on a 15-minute call or in a voice note, and send your logo and some photos if you have them. We write the words, you check the site on your phone, and it goes live within 7 days of us getting your details.
- We reply to every enquiry within 24 hours.
